posts.title: What Happens After AI Gets Smarter Than Every Human?
posts.description: AI progress in mathematics raises a question I cannot shake: if machines eventually reason beyond our best minds, will their discoveries still make sense to us?

posts.title: Fable Made the AI Compute Boom Make Sense
posts.description: A few days with Claude Fable changed how I think about AI compute: capable local models could handle everyday work while large clusters make sustained investigations affordable.

posts.title: GPT-5.6 Found the Web Interface I Was Missing
posts.description: Codex and GPT-5.6 helped me investigate a device I own and build a local browser interface after the official web option disappeared. It changed which personal projects feel worth trying.
